correctness.rationale: All integers n>=2 covered by the exact three pairwise gcd formulas. The Herzog–Watanabe three-generator characterization has its minimality and gcd hypotheses checked. Pair (a,b) gives only n=2 using 2c<3a<ineligible for n>=10 and a separate n=6 residue argument. Pair (b,c) gives no index by a modulo-3 obstruction. Pair (a,c) gives only n=8 via n=25 modular exclusion and 16c<17b<18a for n>=42; the implied y=17n/(2n+1) lies strictly between 8 and 9. CI relations, Frobenius and genus follow by standard gluing. Independently implemented exact Apéry and gluing checks passed n=2..120; finite work is supplementary.

value.rationale: The complete classification for the natural family of three consecutive centered triangular integers is a motivated infinite-parameter structural theorem with sporadic indices 2 and 8. The outer gcd jump at prime 17 yields a non-obvious isolated complete intersection and explicit Hilbert/Frobenius/genus information. It is neither a table recomputation nor a routine substitution into 2024 generalized-star formulas, whose coefficient range excludes centered triangular numbers.
